main_text.p: שמר Niphal נשמר Hiphil השמיר Perdi-dit, Disperdidit. Chald. Infinit. להשמדה Disperdendo, Dan.7.26.
שמח Latari, Latum, Hilarem esse: metapho-ricè, Clarefcere, Lucere. Pihel שמח Latifi-care, Exhilarare. Hiphil השמיח idem.
שמט Intermisit, Intermisionem fecit-: Di-misit, Demisit, Deturbavit. Niphal נשמט Subducere se. Hiphil השמיט Intermisit.
שמאל שמל m. Sinistra manus vel pars, Sinistrum latus.
השמאיל Hiphil Sinistram petere, Ad sinistram flectere vel divertere.
שמלה f. Vestis, Vestimentum: plur. שמלות.

שמם Defolare, Defolari, Obstupescere. Niphal נשם idem. Pihel משומם Defolans; & Stupens, Obstupefactus. Hiphil השם Defolare: Stupere, Stupore correpti. Hophal הושם Defolari. Hith. Obstupescere: Defolationem accersere sibi. Chald. Præ-

page.notes: Hebrew vocalisation and some Hebrew forms in the entries are only partly legible on the scan; the Hebrew letters above are best readings and may contain errors. The page number reads 353 with some doubt. The catchword "Præ-" is at the foot right.
